executed.detail: Not run per sandbox constraint: the PostgreSQL integration database is unavailable. Read the tenant-isolation assertion in test_heal_isolates_checkout_and_usage_reservations_across_tenants and the duplicate-key/no-row-deletion assertions in test_heal_refuses_duplicate_seller_wide_checkout_keys_without_deleting_rows.

new_findings.title: Drained-writer heal command has no production execution context
new_findings.defect: The runbook gives `ACX_USAGE_SCHEMA_WRITERS_DRAINED=1 python -m scripts.sync_identity_schema` without a working directory or container context. In production, the host stack directory contains Compose files while the heal module is packaged in the backend image at /app/scripts (apps/prototype-description-service/Dockerfile:159-168), so host Python from /opt/acx-backend/prod cannot import it.
new_findings.failure_scenario: After draining writers, an operator runs the documented command from /opt/acx-backend/prod; Python cannot resolve scripts.sync_identity_schema and the schema upgrade is not applied.
new_findings.fix: Document a production container invocation from /opt/acx-backend/prod, such as `docker compose -f docker-compose.env.yml -f docker-compose.admin.yml run --rm -e ACX_USAGE_SCHEMA_WRITERS_DRAINED=1 api python -m scripts.sync_identity_schema`; state the service-directory context if retaining a local invocation.

new_findings.title: Column-drift recovery probe is not a runnable URL check
new_findings.defect: The runbook says `curl -s .../recognition/tenant/whoami`; the ellipsis is not a URL, and `-s` does not make an HTTP status visible even though the text says to confirm HTTP 200.
new_findings.failure_scenario: An operator copies the recovery probe after healing; curl rejects the literal ellipsis target, so the runbook provides no endpoint result to confirm the repair.
new_findings.fix: Replace the ellipsis with the deployed API base URL, then use curl with --fail, --silent, --show-error, and --write-out so HTTP errors fail and the status code is visible.

new_findings.title: Local reset script path does not resolve from the repository root
new_findings.defect: The runbook names `scripts/reset_dev_db.sh` as the local reset command, but the script exists at `apps/prototype-description-service/scripts/reset_dev_db.sh`; there is no root-level scripts/reset_dev_db.sh.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A local operator follows the reset note from the repository root and gets a missing-file error, leaving the documented greenfield recovery path unperformed.
new_findings.fix: Use the repository-root-relative path `apps/prototype-description-service/scripts/reset_dev_db.sh` or explicitly direct the operator to change into apps/prototype-description-service before running `scripts/reset_dev_db.sh`.

summary: The RLS audit now includes billing_checkout_attempt, and the inspected schema tests assert tenant isolation and seller-wide duplicate protection; three documented commands still cannot run as written. The assigned lane check passed, while the PostgreSQL integration suite was recorded not_run because this sandbox has no database.
